name: Norma Natalie Rodarte
office: Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Norma Natalie Rodarte is a retired Whittier City School District employee running for the Whittier City School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 3. She started with the district as a clerk in 1988 and later worked as a noon duty aide, instructional aide, and administrative secretary for a principal, mostly at Edwards Middle School, before retiring in 2021. She says a school board should provide strong leadership, establish clear policies, oversee the district's budget, and focus on student success.
